issues.title: No real rain forecast this week for 5 of 5 Warning counties
issues.detail: Under 0.1 inch in the next 7 days at the county center: Alamosa, Colorado, Saguache, Colorado, Dimmit, Texas, Webb, Texas, Zapata, Texas. A week's forecast says nothing about the season. It only means no relief is on the way right now.
issues.who: Everyone planning water for the next week

issues.title: Live river flow in Big Bend
issues.detail: Rio Grande near Castolon: 45 cubic feet per second; Rio Grande at Rio Grande Village: 170 cubic feet per second. Both gauges are upstream of the canal districts. Flow near the districts is measured by the boundary commission, which has no open data service.
